notes.title: Common bugs and tempoarary fixes!
notes.content:
There are some bugs in the game that I am in the middle of patching however there are some tempoarary solutions to anyone who needs it NOW! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Bug 1. Game crashes after "login" page:[/h2]
This happends when the game trys to load a steam friend that has an animated icon
To tempoararly solve this issue you can play the game while being logged out on steam so that the friends list wont load and there for wont crash.

[contains poteintal spoiler below]
[h2]Bug 2. The your_world.exe section is black! [/h2]
If you have been having issues with "your_world.exe" being blank there is a temporary solution of turning the "Antialiasing - Mode" in your Nvida control pannel to "Enhance the application settings"
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mDpw36B0/lifesaver.png[/img]

[contains spoiler below]
[h2]Bug 3. Game crahes after the game turns off your monitor.[/h2]
You can use "streamer mode" in settings to tempoararly solve this issue (once streamer mode enabled youll have to restart the game for the changes to take place)

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
Woo! First patch since I got my pc wiped.
If there are major export issues I may have to revert.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Monitor will not turn off at house when in streamer mode.
[*] Removed fake "Kinito given permissions" pop up -> to many people thought it was a real virus lol
[*] Stutter removed after Kinito is given permission
[*] Attempted to fix issue: crash after login
[*] Attempted to fix issue: your_world.exe would be blacked out.
[/list]
